leadText:
Crimson (Japanese: チシヲ Chishio) is a character of the day who appeared in Beating the Bustle and Hustle!. She is part of a criminal duo with Azure.

Crimson and Azure both became contestants on the television program Sinnoh Pokémon Hustle, but this edition was fabricated by with the hopes of stealing Pokémon. Officer Jenny had been tracking the two for quite some time and disguised herself in order to follow them.

Crimson had entered with her and showed off her acrobatic skills as she and Azure were some of the few people able to beat the challenges in the game show. She and Azure eventually came across the box that Team Rocket had been keeping all of the Poké Balls that they took from the other contestants, and decided to help themselves to it. Team Rocket was thrilled with Azure and Crimson's performances on the course and viewed their heist as having potential, so they helped them escape from Officer Jenny.

Azure and Crimson, however, were determined to remain a duo, and they turned on Team Rocket. Crimson used her Zangoose in a Tag Battle with Azure and his . Both easily defeated and Jessie's Yanmega, but eventually fell to Officer Jenny's Growlithe. Both Crimson and Azure were arrested by Officer Jenny and taken to jail.
